literal: The family called undiminishing lamp, [when] the dirt called laziness spreads, having been extinguished will perish.
translation: The unfailing lamp of one's family will be extinguished and destroyed when the soot of laziness spreads over it.
modern: குடி என்னும் அணையாத விளக்கு, மடி என்னும் மாசு படிந்தால் அணைந்து அழிந்துவிடும்.
explanation: This couplet uses the metaphor of a lamp to describe a family's reputation and prosperity. The family is called an 'undiminishing lamp' that shines brightly across generations. Laziness is compared to 'dirt' (மாசு), which in the context of a lamp specifically means the soot that creeps over it. When the soot of laziness spreads, it blocks the light and eventually extinguishes the flame, causing the family's greatness to perish. The imagery clearly warns that sloth destroys a household's enduring legacy.
